    arm = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=arm_center_y,
        width=0.26,
        height=arm_height,
        angle=0.0,
        density=28.0,
    )
    # Anchor the pivot to the ground
    sandbox.add_joint(arm, None, (pivot_x, pivot_y), type="pivot")
    
    # Create a heavier, larger head to increase impact force
    head_y = arm_center_y - arm_height / 2
    head = sandbox.add_beam(
        x=pivot_x,
        y=head_y,
        width=0.6,
        height=0.6,
        angle=0.0,
        density=100.0,  # Increased density to enhance mass
    )
    # Rigidly connect head to the bottom of the arm
    head_anchor = (pivot_x, head_y)

    sandbox.set_material_properties(arm, restitution=0.2)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(head, restitution=0.2)
